region.description: Used to find the parent resource to bind the IAM policy to. If not specified, the value will be parsed from the identifier of the parent resource. If no region is provided in the parent identifier and no region is specified, it is taken from the provider configuration.
region.rationale: Entry groups IAM should be created only in approved regions to meet data residency and governance requirements.

entry_group.description: Used to find the parent resource to bind the IAM policy to
entry_group.rationale: This is a user-defined resource reference and does not by itself control access to the underlying resource or data.

project.description: If it is not provided, the project will be parsed from the identifier of the parent resource. If no project is provided in the parent identifier and no project is specified, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: The project ID is an identifier for locating the resource and does not by itself enforce a security control.

member/members.description: Each entry can have one of the following values: * **allUsers**: A special identifier that represents anyone who is on the internet; with or without a Google account. * **allAuthenticatedUsers**: A special identifier that represents anyone who is authenticated with a Google account or a service account. * **user:{emailid}**: An email address that represents a specific Google account. For example, alice@gmail.com or joe@example.com. * **serviceAccount:{emailid}**: An email address that represents a service account. For example, my-other-app@appspot.gserviceaccount.com. * **group:{emailid}**: An email address that represents a Google group. For example, admins@example.com. * **domain:{domain}**: A G Suite domain (primary, instead of alias) name that represents all the users of that domain. For example, google.com or example.com. * **projectOwner:projectid**: Owners of the given project. For example, "projectOwner:my-example-project" * **projectEditor:projectid**: Editors of the given project. For example, "projectEditor:my-example-project" * **projectViewer:projectid**: Viewers of the given project. For example, "projectViewer:my-example-project"
member/members.rationale: IAM members should not include public principals because this could expose catalog metadata broadly.

role.description: `google_data_catalog_entry_group_iam_binding` can be used per role. Note that custom roles must be of the format `[projects\|organizations]/{parent-name}/roles/{role-name}`.
role.rationale: IAM roles should avoid over-privileged roles and follow least privilege.

policy_data.description: (Required only by `google_data_catalog_entry_group_iam_policy`) The policy data generated by a `google_iam_policy` data source.
policy_data.rationale: IAM policy data should not include public members or over-privileged roles.
